title: Verify: planPreload and resolveTextureKey unit tests
summary: Unit tests for the preload planner and resolver
description: Pure unit tests with in-memory manifest and scene objects; no filesystem.
acceptance_criteria: planPreload test asserts deduplicated entries and the unknown ref issue
resolveTextureKey test asserts the fallback key for an unknown id
technical_constraints: Fixture shape mirrors assetSchema and sceneSchema in game/src

steps.symbol: new: planPreload dedupes and reports unknown refs
steps.action: Build a manifest with assets 'a' and 'b' (types per assetSchema) and a scene whose two objects use 'a', one object uses 'missing', and a dust effect uses 'b'. Assert entries ids equal ['a','b'] and issues has length 1 with message containing 'missing'.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/preload.test.ts -t planPreload

steps.action: Assert resolveTextureKey('a', new Set(['a'])) === 'a' and resolveTextureKey('x', new Set(['a'])) === FALLBACK_ASSET_ID.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/preload.test.ts -t resolveTextureKey
